feat-vault-hardening.description: Post-EP-V (V1-V10) reality: at-rest hardening (0600 files, 0700 dirs, no shadow fallback write while the keyring works, machine-bound wrapping key with backward-compatible legacy reads). OpenBao is NOT a working fetch: OpenBaoSecretStore and fetch_from_openbao are deprecated non-functional stubs (ProviderError / placeholder string) and stay that way. dashboard_leases builds masked VaultDashboardLease entries but no HTTP route consumes it.
